params.name: Carcass
params.note: A Bowers Fly Baby rebuilt from three wrecks: a grey cowl, a red cockpit section and a blue tail cone, a cream starboard wing and a silver port one, a primer-green rudder. Open cockpit with plywood cheek boards, a square military windscreen frame with two shards of perspex left in it, a scaffold roll bar with a sofa cushion for a headrest, a cabane and landing and flying wires, steel-tube main gear and a tailwheel. The tube aft of the firewall and every cockpit fitting are the interior's (interior-carcass.js); see scripts/shapes/fw-meshes/carcass.mjs.
